rules.DEADLINE: Early band (1-30): 10th business day after today; from 2026-11-02 credit cards in the early band only: 5th business day. Late band (31-90): last business day of the month, or of next month if today is that day.
rules.BDAY: Mon-Fri minus 2026-11-11, 11-26, 11-27, 12-25, 2027-01-01. The withdrawn email's 2026-12-24 closure never applies.
rules.FLOOR: minimum_payment (card) / instalment_amount (loan) in both bands; the withdrawn email's full-amount floor for late loans never applies.
rules.LADDER: Two attempts per band after the opening ask: full on last business day of this week (next week's if today is that day), floor on deadline; clamped to deadline.
rules.IDENTITY: phone_last4 then date_of_birth; third wrong answer fails.
rules.CODES: Table N-4 codes; DSP replaces retired DISP; restructuring to restructuring queue (email withdrawn).
